name: AAYNA
bio_excerpt: Aayna is a DJ and producer whose sets are shaped by the Roland TB-303 and 1980s and 1990s acid house. She has played Magnetic Fields, DGTL, Echoes of Earth and Grasslands Festival in Nepal, and played for the UK community Keep Hush.

name: ANISH SOOD
bio_excerpt: Anish Sood records as Anyasa and was born in Goa in 1989. He debuted on Anjunadeep in July 2021 with the single Rasiya, reported as the first Indian artist signed to the label. He also runs the label Class Action.

name: DISCOKID
bio_excerpt: Discokid is the DJ name of Fatema Hakim, a disco and funk DJ from India. She is resident DJ at the Paradise Disco pop-up and started Disco Diwali in 2021. She played Mixmag's The Lab Goa in January 2022.
